claims.assertion: Anéeka describes Taygeta as strongly matriarchal, with women holding social control while men remain included.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says this does not nullify men.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetans treat menstruation as normal and respect it; people may use the period to rest and pause routine.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She contrasts this with Earth’s stigma.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetan pregnancies last about nine to ten months; births are usually natural and often underwater.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says cesarean delivery is reserved for severe problems.
